notes.title: Escape Yourself v2.0.2.3 - NOW FREE TO PLAY!
notes.content:
Hello everybody! 
With the arrival of the 2.0.2.3 update, Escape Yourself becomes completely free!

New update:
-Replaced manual save with automatic save.
-The difficulty of the spider minigame has been balanced.
-Fixed minor bugs.
-Minor graphic changes.

notes.title: Escape Yourself Now Available!
notes.content:
Play this new Visual Novel and Escape Room!
You will take on the role of Danny Bent, a boy who wakes up in a train car. Without memories and without knowing why he is there, he soon realizes that something strange is going on. Can you solve all the puzzles? Of discovering the truth? Will you be able to escape?
